lines.zh: 我尾巴平举，在蕨丛里穿行。
lines.en: Tail level, I thread through the ferns.
My fine scales rasp through the ferns.
I set my claws down light, step by step.
I hold my tail level to steady myself.
My three-toed prints stay in the mud.

lines.zh: 我绕着自己的巢走一圈。
lines.en: I circle my own nest once.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，贴着灌木走。
lines.en: I crouch low and walk along the bushes.

lines.zh: 我单脚站着，另一只爪悬空。
lines.en: I stand on one foot, the other claw raised.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只脚，久久不放。
lines.en: I lift one foot and hold it there.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里滚出细碎咕噜。
lines.en: A low rattle rolls in my throat.
I tilt my head at a distant sound.

lines.zh: 我尾巴尖一下一下地摆。
lines.en: My tail tip flicks, again and again.

lines.zh: 你的脚印停在蕨叶下面。
lines.en: Your footprints stop beneath the fern.

lines.zh: 脚趾上的镰爪，已经抬起来了。
lines.en: The sickle claw on my toe is already raised.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，喉咙里滚出低鸣。
lines.en: I open my beak and a low growl rolls out.

lines.zh: 我一只眼转看你，另一只不动。
lines.en: One eye turns to you; the other holds still.

lines.zh: 我从头到脚看了你一遍。
lines.en: I look you over from head to toe.
My neck curves as I weigh you.

lines.zh: 我的视线在你手上停了一下。
lines.en: My gaze pauses on your hands.
Each move you make earns a nod from me.
The claws are still here — I can grab even while hurting.

lines.zh: 我的后腿被扯开一道口子。
lines.en: A gash is torn in my hind leg.
My foot is hurt, can't move!
My wound is bleeding, it hurts!
I'm injured, I need to rest!

lines.zh: 你靠近得太近了，感受我的利爪！
lines.en: You're too close! Feel my claws!

lines.zh: 你有资格成为我的猎物吗？
lines.en: Are you worthy of my prey?
My sickle claw folds and springs again.
My strength is more than you can imagine!
This meat could keep me tearing all day.
You knock me a step sideways.
My bones are as hard as iron!
You can't break through my defenses!

lines.zh: 我的体型让你难以撼动！
lines.en: My size makes you hard to shake!
Sickle claws dig in, and the shove lands harder.

lines.zh: 我的胸口撞上你的盾沿。
lines.en: My chest hits the rim of your shield.

lines.zh: 你碰到了我，但伤不到我！
lines.en: You touched me, but can't hurt me!

lines.zh: 我的体型让你难以对付！
lines.en: My size makes you hard to deal with!
Finding a mate is my purpose!
I'm the ruler of the territory!

lines.zh: 我的伴侣能共享我的荣耀！

lines.en: Show your claws, then I'll consider.

lines.zh: 让我们共舞，让领地见证！
lines.en: Let's dance, let the territory witness!
I'm the king of the territory!
Dance with me, share the territory!

lines.zh: 搜寻新鲜血液，我的领地。

lines.en: Juveniles are easy prey, be cautious.

lines.zh: 我的镰爪抬起，草叶压平。
lines.en: My sickle claw lifts; the grass flattens.

lines.zh: 猎物落入视野，发起攻击。

lines.en: My second toe has already left the ground.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，尾巴慢慢绷直。
lines.en: I crouch low, tail slowly going taut.
You have stepped onto my ground.
I go silent in the grass.
I press my foot into the soil.
My claws dig in, and I leap.

lines.zh: 镰刀爪抬起来，专踩要害。
lines.en: My sickle claw lifts; I aim for the vitals.
I hop half a step at your flank.

lines.zh: 我的爪尖敲地，一声接一声。
lines.en: My claws tap the ground, beat after beat.
My tail feathers lift; the wind grows loud.
I wait for your shoulders to relax.
My head going down means I am coming.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶！”，它用锋利的爪子攻击！
lines.en: Sssss! It attacks with sharp claws!
Be careful, its claws are dangerous!

lines.zh: 它的利爪在空气中划过！
lines.en: Its claws slice through the air!

lines.zh: 快速躲避它的致命一击！
它的利爪如刀锋一样锐利！
lines.en: Its claws are as sharp as knives!

lines.zh: 它的腿骨可以击碎石块！
lines.en: Its leg bones can crush stones!

lines.zh: 我的趾爪划开你的护甲。
lines.en: My claw slices your armor open.
I lunge and bite, teeth like a saw.
I rake three times and back off half a step.
On the territory border, beware of attacks!

lines.zh: 黎明前的黑暗，恐爪龙出没！
森林深处，恐爪龙的领地！
山洞入口，恐爪龙的巢穴！

lines.en: Be on guard, Deinonychus is here!

lines.zh: 深山密林，恐爪龙的家园！
lines.en: Deep in the woods, Deinonychus' home!

lines.zh: 泥地里先露出我的一只爪。
lines.en: One of my claws breaks the mud first.
I rise out of the ferns.

lines.zh: 一窝蛋旁多了我这个守巢者。
lines.en: A nest of eggs gains me as its guardian.

lines.zh: 树林里的鸟叫忽然停了。
lines.en: The forest birds suddenly go quiet.
I step out from behind a fallen log.

lines.zh: 我的脚印从河边一路到这里。
lines.en: My prints run from the river to here.
I shake the mud off me.

lines.zh: 我在蕨叶间发出第一声低鸣。
lines.en: I give my first low cry among the ferns.
I stop at the border of my ground.
Flame curls over my tail feathers.
An arrow lodges in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 紫色的光烧穿了我的鳞。
lines.en: Purple light burns through my scales.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背脊，鳞片焦了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my spine; scales sear.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我的镰爪抓不住。
lines.en: The ground is gone; my sickle claws catch nothing.
